deed: צהל פתח מחדש בית-חולים נטוש בקהרמאנמרש ו-470 בני אדם קיבלו בו טיפול
title: An IDF delegation reopened an abandoned hospital in Kahramanmaraş, Turkey, and hundreds of wounded were treated there

trailer.text: The IDF has led 31 search and rescue delegations abroad over the past 40 years.
On February 6, 2023, a 7.8-magnitude earthquake struck southern Turkey and northern Syria, and two days later a medical aid delegation sent by Israel arrived in Turkey.
In the city of Kahramanmaraş the delegation helped reopen a local hospital, which, according to the IDF, was housed in the building of an abandoned medical center.
According to the IDF, in seven days of continuous effort the delegation treated more than 470 injured civilians, including about 150 children.

When the Home Front Command search and rescue delegation returned to Israel, Prime Minister Netanyahu told it that all of Israel was proud of it. At that time, the IDF field hospital was still operating in Turkey.

paragraphs.text: On February 6, 2023, a 7.8-magnitude earthquake struck southern and central Turkey and northern and western Syria.
Kahramanmaraş was the epicenter of one of the two earthquakes that devastated southern Turkey and neighboring Syria.
As of Tuesday night, the death toll in Turkey and Syria was at least 7,100.
By Thursday evening it had reached nearly 20,000.
According to an article written about the aid, more than 100 nations and international organizations mounted a massive, unprecedented response.
A delegation of IDF Medical and Logistics Corps troops was set to depart for Turkey on Wednesday morning.
The IDF said the delegation would number about 230 people, including search and rescue experts, military medics, and Health Ministry doctors, nurses and paramedics.
Representatives of Magen David Adom and other bodies also took part in the delegation.
According to the plan, the field hospital delegation was to be led by the commander of the Home Front Command Search and Rescue Brigade, Col. Elad Edri.
The preparations were led by the deputy chief of the Medical Corps, Col. Dr. Tomer Koller, who was to manage the hospital on the ground.
Avital Dotan, a nurse from Hadassah, was chosen to fly with the delegation.
According to the IDF, 15 Air Force cargo planes flew hundreds of tons of equipment and about 230 participants to Turkey.

The medical delegation brought to Turkey 7 tons of medical equipment dedicated to operating rooms, emergency rooms, admission and intensive care. Alongside it, the delegation brought another 10 tons of additional medical equipment and about 10 tons of logistics and administrative equipment.
It included doctors, nurses, surgeons, anesthesiologists, X-ray technicians, laboratory technicians, paramedics and medical logistics personnel.

According to an article written about the aid, under the guidance of the local health authorities it was decided to support an existing medical facility rather than establish an independent field facility.
According to the article, aid teams should arrive in a disaster zone only after a formal request, and operate in full coordination with the host country.
Dr. Ella Shayer wrote that the local staff left the hospital during the first tremor and did not return to work there.
According to her, volunteer doctors from all over Turkey came to take their place, but the hospital did not open.
According to her, one floor below ground was filled with black bags on the floor.
A doctor from the delegation told Anadolu Agency that they entered the hospital when it was deserted.
According to him, they brought staff and equipment: emergency, recovery and operating rooms, a dental clinic and a radiology department.
According to Shayer, the delegation members lived on the fourth floor of the building.
Israeli engineers inspected it and found it safe, despite cracks in the walls and fallen cabinets.
The hospital was fully operational from Friday morning.
It provided intensive care, pediatrics, general surgery and orthopedics.
Shayer wrote that about 140 people were treated in one day, and that people rescued from the rubble kept arriving.
According to her, the intensive care unit and the inpatient ward filled up, and the abandoned building filled with life.
The temporary Turkish emergency room continued to operate, but more and more cases were referred directly to the Israeli team.
According to the IDF, the patients included about 150 children and about 50 dental patients.
In addition, 10 surgical and orthopedic operations were performed.
The delegation also treated wounded Syrians who were in Turkey at the time of the earthquakes.
A doctor from the delegation said they treated not only earthquake victims but also chronic patients.
Alongside the hospital, the delegation's rescue forces also worked in the field.
One of those rescued was 9-year-old Ridvan, the delegation's 19th rescue and the third member of his family rescued alive.
A pediatrician from the delegation treated him during the complex rescue.
IDF rescue teams also retrieved from the rubble the bodies of Saul and Fortuna Cenudioglu, the heads of the Jewish community in Antakya.
According to the IDF, the number of rescues was unprecedented compared to its previous rescue missions.
According to the IDF, a 4-year-old Syrian refugee boy whose parents were killed in the earthquake was treated at the hospital.
He was the only survivor of his family.
A nurse in the delegation gave him a halva snack from the delegation members' combat rations, to calm him during treatment.
The boy's uncle told an Israeli nurse: "You Israelis treat us better than our people."
According to a doctor from the delegation, a Syrian child aged 4–5 arrived at the hospital after five days under the rubble, without food or water.
The deputy chief of Israel's mission in Turkey told of a 4-year-old boy rescued by Israeli teams.
According to him, the boy arrived at the emergency department very cold, and was treated by the emergency and intensive care staff.
According to Dr. Raymond Mokled of the Israeli delegation, Turkish medical teams came to the hospital in the past two days and began working together with the Israeli team to treat the injured.
According to Avital Dotan's diary, the Turkish teams worked with the Israelis so that treatment would continue after the delegation left.
Shayer wrote that the team began to think about handing over to the local teams.
She concluded that the hospital was undergoing a successful resuscitation, and that in her view they had not come in vain.
Col. Dr. Tomer Koller said the delegation worked shoulder to shoulder with the Turkish teams.
The delegation returned to Israel aboard Air Force aircraft.
When the Home Front Command search and rescue delegation returned to Israel, Netanyahu told it that it had brought great honor to the State of Israel.
Maj. Gen. Michel Yanko told its members that they had embodied the truest face of the IDF and the State of Israel.
Before departure, the Chief of the Medical Corps, Brig. Gen. Dr. Alon Glasberg, said that this was a difficult hour for the Turkish nation and that Israel was proud it could come and assist.

According to the President's Office, in a conversation held on the day of the earthquake, Erdoğan thanked Herzog for his good wishes and for the rescue mission, and emphasized that the assistance would greatly aid the many forces operating on the ground.
Erdoğan stressed that the assistance would greatly aid the many forces operating on the ground.
A United Hatzolah delegation cut short its mission and returned to Israel early over security concerns.
Syrian sources vigorously denied requesting aid from Israel.
IDF spokesman Ran Kochav said the military was not involved in potential aid to Syria.

claims.text: לפי הרופא, ילד סורי בן 4-5 הגיע לבית החולים אחרי חמישה ימים מתחת להריסות בלי מזון ומים.
claims.quote: He further said that a Syrian child, between the ages of 4 and 5, arrived at the hospital after being under the rubble for five days without food or drink.

claims.text: לפי סגן ראש הנציגות, ילד בן 4 שחולץ על ידי צוותים ישראליים הגיע למיון במצב קר מאוד ובטמפרטורה נמוכה, וטופל בידי צוות המיון והטיפול הנמרץ.
claims.quote: He arrived in a very cold state with low temperature at the emergency department,” wrote Markman.

claims.text: לפי הרופא, צוותים רפואיים טורקיים הגיעו לבית החולים ביומיים האחרונים והחלו לעבוד יחד לטיפול בפצועים.
claims.quote: He said Turkish medical teams came to the hospital in the past two days, and started working together to treat the injured.

claims.text: לפי יומנה של דותן, הצוותים הטורקיים נכנסו לעניינים ועבדו יחד עם הצוות הישראלי כדי שהטיפול יימשך אחרי עזיבתו.
claims.quote: הטורקים ממש נכנסים פה לעניינים, לאחר הפוגה, מסדרים את המחלקה בסדר שלהם ואנחנו עובדים יחד איתם

claims.text: הכותבת כתבה שהצוות מתחיל לחשוב על ימי שגרה ועל העברת השרביט לצוותים המקומיים.
claims.quote: ואנחנו מתחילים לחשוב על ימים של שגרה והעברת השרביט לצוותים המקומיים

claims.text: הכותבת סיכמה שבית החולים עובר החייאה מוצלחת ושלדעתה לא יצאו לחינם.
claims.quote: בית החולים עובר החייאה מוצלחת. נראה לי שלא יצאנו לחינם.

claims.text: קולונל ד"ר תומר קולר אמר שהמשלחת סיימה את משימתה אחרי שמונה ימים שבהם טיפלה בכ-470 אזרחים חולים ופצועים, בעבודה כתף אל כתף עם הצוותים הטורקיים.
claims.quote: Our mission ended today, following eight days during which we treated about 470 sick and wounded civilians, working shoulder-to-shoulder with the Turkish teams with one shared goal - to save lives.

claims.text: המשלחת חזרה לישראל במטוסי חיל האוויר.
claims.quote: The delegation returned to Israel aboard IAF aircraft.

claims.text: נתניהו אמר למשלחת שהביאה כבוד גדול למדינת ישראל.
claims.quote: You brought great honour to the State of Israel.

claims.text: ראש אגף טכנולוגיה ולוגיסטיקה, אלוף מישל יאנקו, אמר לחברי המשלחת שהם גילמו את הפנים האמיתיות ביותר של צה"ל ושל מדינת ישראל.
claims.quote: You embodied the truest face of the IDF and the State of Israel.

claims.text: גלסברג אמר שזו שעה קשה לעם הטורקי ושישראל גאה שהיא יכולה לבוא לסייע.
claims.quote: This is a difficult hour for the Turkish nation, and we are proud that we can come and assist

claims.text: לפי לשכת הנשיא, ארדואן הודה להרצוג על איחוליו ועל משימת ההצלה, והדגיש שהסיוע יסייע מאוד לכוחות הרבים הפועלים בשטח.
claims.quote: Erdoğan thanked Herzog for his good wishes and for the rescue mission and underscored that this assistance will greatly aid the many forces

claims.text: משלחת של איחוד הצלה קיצרה את משימתה וחזרה לישראל מוקדם מטעמי ביטחון.
claims.quote: a delegation from the United Hatzolah emergency response organisation cut short its mission and returned to Israel early over security concerns.

claims.text: מקורות סוריים הכחישו בתוקף שביקשו סיוע מישראל, ודובר צה"ל רן כוכב אמר שהצבא אינו מעורב בסיוע אפשרי לסוריה.
claims.quote: But Syrian sources vigorously denied requesting aid from Israel, and IDF spokesman Ran Kochav told reporters that the military was not involved in potential aid to Syria.

claims.text: לפי Science.co.il, צוות החילוץ מנה כ-150 איש והצוות הרפואי 250 איש.
claims.quote: The rescue team includes about 150 people and the medical team includes 250 people.

claims.text: משלחת שנייה של צה"ל שנחתה ביום רביעי הקימה בן לילה בית חולים שדה בפאתי קהרמאנמרש.
claims.quote: Meanwhile, a second IDF delegation that landed in the country on Wednesday established a field hospital on the outskirts of the city of Kahramanmaraş overnight.

claims.text: לפי גורמים ישראליים, בית חולים השדה טיפל עד כה ב-412 איש וימשיך לפעול לפחות עד סוף השבוע.
claims.quote: According to Israeli officials, the field hospital has so far treated 412 people. It will continue to operate at least until the end of this week.

claims.text: סגן ראש נציגות ישראל בטורקיה כתב ביום ראשון שיותר מ-300 איש טופלו בבית החולים שהקימה ישראל.
claims.quote: More than 300 people have been treated in a field hospital set up by Israel in Turkey, the deputy chief of Israel’s mission in Turkey wrote on Sunday.

claims.text: לפי TOI, צוותי החילוץ הצליחו לחלץ 19 אזרחים טורקים מתחת להריסות.
claims.quote: The search and rescue teams managed to rescue 19 Turkish civilians from under the rubble.

quote_translations.c45: We are living on the fourth floor of the abandoned hospital, in the city of Kahramanmaraş, a city located at an altitude of 700 meters, in southern Turkey and close to the Syrian border.
quote_translations.c55: Avital Dotan, a nurse in the recovery and intensive care unit at Hadassah, was chosen to fly with the IDF delegation to Turkey, where she is taking part in setting up and operating a field hospital.
quote_translations.c61: The medical delegation brought with it into Turkey 7 tons of medical equipment designated for operating rooms, emergency, admission and intensive care
quote_translations.c47: The hospital's local staff left the building during the first tremor and never returned to work in it.
quote_translations.c48: Volunteer doctors from all over Turkey came to take their place, but the hospital did not open.
quote_translations.c49: Floor minus one of the hospital is occupied by black bags lying on the floor.
quote_translations.c46: The building in which we are staying was inspected by Israeli engineers and found safe, despite the cracks in the walls and the fallen cabinets in the rooms.
quote_translations.c50: Today alone about 140 people were treated. People rescued from the ruins keep arriving.
quote_translations.c51: The intensive care unit is filling up, and so is the inpatient ward. The abandoned building is filling with life
quote_translations.c52: The Turkish emergency room in the temporary structure is still working, but more and more cases are referred to us directly
quote_translations.c57: Ridvan is the delegation's 19th rescue and the third rescued alive from the same family.
quote_translations.c58: Ridvan received medical treatment from an expert pediatrician from the Israeli delegation
quote_translations.c59: The child lost his parents and he is the only one of his family members who survived.
quote_translations.c60: To calm the child during his treatment, the nurse gave him a halva snack from the delegation members' combat rations.
quote_translations.c56: The Turks are really getting into things here, after a pause, arranging the ward in their own order, and we are working together with them
quote_translations.c53: And we are starting to think about days of routine and handing over to the local teams
quote_translations.c54: The hospital is undergoing a successful resuscitation. I think we did not come out for nothing.
